contributor.name: Community
contributor.notes: E-GMP Remote Climate Start (Timed Fallback). Wakes bus via 0x562 AUTOSAR NM frame, runs 15s HV pre-charge loop via 0x4F1 (00 F0), broadcasts 0x4F1 (00 D0) command active while firing 0x4A2 prepare & execute macros, then closes session with 0x4F1 (00 C0) idle.

contributor.name: Community
contributor.notes: E-GMP Remote Climate Start (Smart Mode). Sends 0x562 ECU wakeup, broadcasts 0x4F1 (00 F0) while monitoring CAN 0x038 for Byte 6 == 0x82 (HV Ready). Once armed, broadcasts 0x4F1 (00 D0) for 4s, executes 0x4A2 prepare & execute macros, and cleanly closes session with 0x4F1 (00 C0) idle.

ha_metadata.name: Direct Head Unit DATC Remote Climate

contributor.name: SuaveEV & HKMC Decompilation Research
contributor.notes: Direct Head Unit DATC (Dual Automatic Temperature Control) CAN frame (0x520 / 0x5A0) decoded from HKMC_TAppService DATCManager. Byte 0 enables HVAC (0x01), Byte 1 sets target temp in 0.5 deg C steps (raw = Temp_C * 2, e.g. 68°F=20.0°C=0x28, 70°F=21.0°C=0x2A, 72°F=22.0°C=0x2C, 74°F=23.5°C=0x2F, 76°F=24.5°C=0x31), Byte 2 controls blower & auto mode (0x04), Byte 3 controls air distribution (0x01 vent). The vehicle VCU automatically engages High Voltage contactors and runs the electric compressor / PTC heater when this frame is periodically broadcast alongside 0x4F1 CLU keep-alive.

contributor.name: SuaveEV & HKMC Decompilation Research
contributor.notes: Front axle tire pressure and temperature telemetry decoded from TPMS_01_200ms_1 (0x3A1). Bytes 0-1 Front Left PSI/kPa, Byte 2 Front Left temp, Bytes 3-4 Front Right PSI/kPa, Byte 5 Front Right temp, Byte 6 Low pressure alert flag.

contributor.name: SuaveEV & HKMC Decompilation Research

contributor.name: SuaveEV & HKMC Decompilation Research
contributor.notes: Power Tailgate Module telemetry on CAN 0x3A6 (PTGM_01_200ms) and active command on 0x588 (TMU2). Byte 0 reports opening position (0% closed to 100% open). Byte 1 reports state (Closed, Opening, Closing, Paused, Anti-pinch reverse).
